title: Taint Flow Lab
tagline: Compare static, dynamic, and hybrid taint propagation strategies under increasing codebase size.

curves.label: Path-Sensitive Analysis
curves.code: init=0; for(node=0; node<n; node++){ for(path=0; path<node; path++){ init += 1; }} render(init);
curves.name: Path-Sensitive Analysis

curves.label: Flow-Insensitive Fixpoint
curves.code: work=0; for(iter=0; iter<Math.ceil(Math.log(n+1)); iter++){ for(stmt=0; stmt<n; stmt++){ work += 1; }} render(work);
curves.name: Flow-Insensitive Fixpoint

curves.label: Dynamic Taint Tracking
curves.code: cost=0; for(run=0; run<n; run++){ for(event=0; event<n; event++){ cost += (run+event)%3 ? 1 : 2; }} render(cost);
curves.name: Dynamic Taint Tracking

curves.label: Demand-Driven Hybrid
curves.code: cost=0; for(q=0; q<n; q++){ if((q&q-1)===0){ for(stmt=0; stmt<Math.floor(n*0.12); stmt++){ cost += 2; }} else { cost += 1; }} cost += n*Math.log(n+1); render(cost);
curves.name: Demand-Driven Hybrid

curves.label: Symbolic Summaries
curves.code: cost=0; for(k=1; k<=n; k++){ cost += (k%Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(n))) ? 1 : 7; } cost = cost/10 + 18*Math.log(n+1)+40; render(cost);
curves.name: Symbolic Summaries
